title: Galaxy Types
guideExplore: Compare spiral, elliptical, and irregular galaxies. Spiral arms rotate slowly.
guideSpiral: Spiral galaxies have flat disks and rotating arms — like the Milky Way.
guideElliptical: Elliptical galaxies are smooth ovals with older stars and little gas.
guideIrregular: Irregular galaxies have no defined shape — often from collisions.
conditionsHint: Tap a galaxy or use the menu — spiral arms spin faster than smooth ellipticals.
quizQuestion: Which galaxy type has rotating spiral arms?
learnMore: Astronomers classify galaxies by shape: spiral, elliptical, or irregular.
